response.overview: Mizzou Mixup follows Jack Cooper, an awkward freshman who gets way too blasted at his first-ever college party and wakes up the next morning with almost no memory of what happened. While piecing the night back together, Jack discovers that he somehow ended up caught between two diabetic girls who both think he’s interested in them—and neither knows about the other. What starts as a simple misunderstanding spirals into a chaotic campus love triangle involving mixed-up insulin bags, increasingly elaborate lies, and Jack desperately trying to survive his first weekend at Mizzou without losing both girls—or his dignity.
response.title: Mizzou Mixup
